identity.title: [v0.92][runtime] Operationalize distributed Runtime and polis Observatory across Wuji and AWS

values.review_scope: Production Guardian/kernel and Runtime-init configuration, shepherd_agent_ref and per-node private local-model profiles, three-voter authority composition, one quorum-leased polis Observatory API/WSS, quorum snapshot-root recovery, serial Wuji and two-AZ AWS orchestration, partition/fencing/activation safety, teardown, exact evidence, and operator-gated publication.
review_prompts: Do three real Guardian/kernel voters form one authenticated polis through production entrypoints rather than independent singleton runtimes?
Does runtime configuration bind shepherd_agent_ref and per-node model profiles while proving the shepherd is non-voting and cannot mint authority?
Are all Wuji and AWS model servers private, pinned, resource-bounded, restart-tested, and incapable of changing consensus semantics?
Is there exactly one coherent redacted quorum-leased Observatory per polis, with premature or duplicate ownership denied?
Can Phase B start under any Phase A residue, wrong AWS account, single-AZ topology, public endpoint, or missing cleanup receipt?
Is the snapshot boundary quorum committed, independently materialized identically, and proven through serial AWS compaction/restart without manual copying?
Does live Wuji remain running during an unbridged asymmetric partition while the AWS pair elects, fences, activates, and continues safely?
After healing, is stale Wuji denied until demotion/synchronization, and does re-partition plus opposite-AZ voter loss produce a true one-of-three mutation halt?
Do exact receipts bind source, argv, config, shepherd/model identities, authority transitions, live Observatory captures, AWS account/AZs, and complete teardown without secrets?
